featuredProjectsHeading.title: Selected private homes, villas, and residential studies.

introduction.title: We Want to Understand How You Live.
introduction.copy: Your daily rhythms, the light in your favourite room, how your family gathers, what makes you feel at home — these are the things that shape the architecture. Every detail matters because it's your life that lives there.

servicesHeading.title: Services for Creating Your Home.
servicesHeading.copy: Whether you're starting from scratch, reimagining a space, or bringing a vision to life, we'll guide you through the process.

philosophyHeading.title: What Makes a Home Feel Right.
philosophyHeading.copy: The best homes aren't defined by style or budget — they're defined by how they serve your life. Light, comfort, connection to place, and materials that age beautifully. These are the things that matter.

philosophy.title: Light & Climate
philosophy.copy: How sunlight, shade, and air shape the way your home feels throughout the day. Good architecture makes you feel the seasons change.

philosophy.title: Material & Time
philosophy.copy: Natural materials that age beautifully and improve with use. Your home should become more comfortable and more beautiful as time passes.

philosophy.title: Living & Connection
philosophy.copy: Spaces designed around how you actually live — family gatherings, quiet mornings, everyday rituals. The architecture serves your life, not the other way around.

materials.title: Materials chosen for climate, character, and longevity.
materials.copy: Our material palettes are guided by climate, craftsmanship, and the way a home is lived in over time. We favour natural materials that weather gracefully, create warmth, and bring lasting character to a home.
materials.imageAlt: Ukwala Residence material detail with stone, timber fins, textured plaster, and filtered daylight

principles.title: Light
principles.copy: Materials selected for how they receive and shape daylight.

principles.title: Locality
principles.copy: Regional materials that connect a home to its landscape.

principles.title: Texture
principles.copy: Natural surfaces that add depth without excess ornament.

principles.title: Longevity
principles.copy: Finishes chosen to age gracefully over time.

principles.title: Craft
principles.copy: Carefully detailed materials shaped through skilled making.

principles.title: Permanence
principles.copy: A restrained palette designed to remain relevant for decades.

processHeading.title: A measured process from first conversation to build-ready drawings.
processHeading.copy: Structured for homeowners, diaspora clients, and developers who need clarity, discretion, and careful design work.

process.title: Discovery & Brief
process.copy: We begin by understanding the site, lifestyle, goals, budget, and aspirations that will shape the project.

process.title: Site & Context Analysis
process.copy: Climate, topography, views, access, landscape, and local conditions inform the design direction.

process.title: Concept Design
process.copy: Plans, spatial organization, massing, and early design ideas are developed into a clear architectural concept.

process.title: Design Development
process.copy: Architecture, interiors, materials, landscape integration, and technical requirements are refined into a coordinated design.

process.title: Construction Documentation
process.copy: Detailed drawings and project information are prepared for approvals, pricing, and construction.

process.title: Construction Support
process.copy: We remain involved during construction to clarify drawings, review progress, and support the realization of the design.
